head.title: CLI: add workflows list and workflows run commands
head.summary: The ticket asks for `rootly workflows list` (ID discovery) and `rootly workflows run <id-or-slug> --incident=<id>` so workflow triggering can be scripted or agent-driven instead of Slack-only. Both commands already exist on master, added by rootly-cli PR #56 (merged 2026-08-13, closes GH #51); this lane verified them and plans no code change.

additions.text: Solve IR-6588 — one PR. Add `rootly workflows list` and `rootly workflows run <id-or-slug> --incident=<id>` to the CLI. Ref https://github.com/rootlyhq/rootly-cli/issues/51
